intent: Unify SEIS, SEIS-Cloud, SEIS-Code, SEIS-Design, SEIS-Data, SEIS Security, SEIS Research, SEIS Automation, and SEIS Product into one versioned, repo-contained AI-native agent install surface while keeping older lane packages and personal installs as preserved compatibility paths.

consolidationPolicy.futurePluginIntake: Every future SEIS plugin must be registered in assets/unified-suite.json and embedded under this single public SEIS-Agent install before it is presented as a SEIS capability.

applicationSourceBoundary.futureIntake: New plugins for the SEIS Command Center are created under plugins/seis-core/<plugin-name>, regenerated into the app inventory/catalog, and covered by the unified suite without entering packages/seis-ai or becoming separate marketplace cards.

websiteRoadmap.releasePolicy: Build the website only when SEIS-AI Agent is ready for a deliberate public release decision.
websiteRoadmap.direction: Cinematic, premium, design-driven, accessible, responsive, and grounded in real SEIS product surfaces.

guardrails: keep development inside the SEIS repo
do not deploy, authenticate, or enable live external access before explicit release decision
keep memory and context systems under SEIS-Data and SEIS-Agent governance
validate plugin, terminal install, docs, and generated reports before handoff
